summary: Former Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi was convicted of having sex with an underage prostitute and has been sentenced to seven years in prison and banned from serving in public office, though his sentence does not begin until an appeal process is concluded. He was charged with paying for sex with Karima El Mahroug, a Moroccan-born nightclub dancer known as "Ruby Rubacuori," whom prosecutors say had sex with him at 17; El Mahroug denies having sex with Berlusconi but admits receiving thousands of euros, and the court also found him guilty of abusing his office for pressuring Milan police in May 2010 to release her—a call he says he made believing she was related to former Egyptian president Hosni Mubarak to avoid a diplomatic incident. Prosecutors alleged El Mahroug was part of "a prostitution system set up for the personal sexual satisfaction of the defendant," and in May an Italian appeals court upheld a separate tax fraud conviction that Berlusconi is appealing to the Court of Cassation and which could carry a four-year prison term; Berlusconi is head of the People of Freedom party, part of Italy's coalition government.
